answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade, with the stake sized to the value it handles. Peers audit signed work across a bridge ledger, and if two identities are proven to be one operator, both stakes are slashed. A gale of fake accounts then costs a gale of locked capital: each clone needs its own stake, and one detection burns them all, while honest agents tend one orchard of reputation and get their stake back.
